metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for video processing, transcription, subtitles, and dev workflow orchestration.

plugins.name: process-video
plugins.description: Process videos: optimize for web, transcribe audio with Deepgram Nova 3, add subtitles in any language, translate, and burn into video with customizable styles.

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: Native Claude-Code agentic loop: brainstorm → plan → execute → review → e2e → pr → demo (+ ad-hoc fix). Auto-routes single vs parallel-wave mode, with a hardened environment probe driving capability-gated in-loop E2E and a stall watchdog that recovers hung/silently-killed agents and reports periodic progress. Replaces the Docker-hosted ralphex flow and the retired dev-workflow plugin. Includes auto-generated narrated walkthrough demos (TTS → paced capture → mux → S3).
